Synthetic source JSONL and meta.json files for exact F1–F7 and F9. Generated by the fixture tests in test_adapter.py. Each directory includes its explicit fixture pricing catalog. F6 follows common.md amendment 5: null/missing cost, tokens retained, cost_lower_bound on ancestors. F3 time rollups are computed in tests from emitted intervals, because the adapter does not own storage rollups. F9 includes a parent UUID repeated in an attributed nested fork.

`expected.json` (per fixture, owned by the adapter that reads the fixture): hand-derived values the
canonical stream must reproduce, with a `note`. Adapter-level facts (tokens, cost, link basis, copy
hints) are asserted by `tests/unit/test_adapter_claude.py`; F3 interval metrics, F5 unique cost and
F6 lower-bound ancestors are store results, computed in that test from the emitted leaves and listed
here so the store's tests can assert the same numbers after loading the adapter output.
